en.quote: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?
en.riddle: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?
en.speaker: God

en.12: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?

en.quote: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the LORD. And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.
en.riddle: and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.
en.speaker: LORD

he.quote: וּנְתַתִּיךָ לָעָם הַזֶּה לְחוֹמַת נְחֹשֶׁת בְּצוּרָה וְנִלְחֲמוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְלֹא־יוּכְלוּ לָךְ כִּֽי־אִתְּךָ אֲנִי לְהוֹשִֽׁיעֲךָ וּלְהַצִּילֶךָ נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה וְהִצַּלְתִּיךָ מִיַּד רָעִים וּפְדִתִיךָ מִכַּף עָרִצִֽים
he.speaker: יְהוָֽה

en.20: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
en.21: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.
